events.title: Captain Cook sights Maui on his return to Hawaii
events.description: On his second visit to the Hawaiian Islands, which he called the Sandwich Islands, James Cook sighted Maui. He was killed at Kealakekua Bay on Hawaii Island less than three months later.

events.title: The United States observes a national day of Thanksgiving
events.description: The United States observed a national day of Thanksgiving, proclaimed by President George Washington at the request of Congress to encourage national unity. The new Congress had first met in New York that March.

events.title: Napoleon's retreating army begins crossing the Berezina
events.description: Retreating from Moscow, Napoleon's Grande Armée began fighting its way across the Berezina River, in present-day Belarus, under attack by Russian forces under Wittgenstein and Chichagov. Engineers bridged the river under fire, and much of the army escaped.

events.title: The Podgorica Assembly votes for Montenegro's union with Serbia
events.description: The Podgorica Assembly deposed King Nicholas I and the Petrović-Njegoš dynasty of Montenegro and voted for unconditional union with Serbia, days before the creation of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes. Opponents considered it illegitimate, and the Christmas Uprising followed.

events.title: Howard Carter looks into Tutankhamun's tomb
events.description: Howard Carter made a small hole in the sealed doorway and peered in by candlelight. Asked if he could see anything, he reportedly replied, 'Yes, wonderful things.'

events.title: The Red Army shells Mainila to create a pretext for war
events.description: The Red Army shelled the Soviet border village of Mainila near Beloostrov, and the Soviet Union claimed that the fire came from Finland. The false flag operation gave it a casus belli for launching the Winter War four days later.

events.title: Casablanca premieres in New York
events.description: Casablanca, starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premiered at the Hollywood Theatre weeks after the Allies landed in North Africa. It won three Academy Awards, including Best Picture.

events.title: France launches its first satellite
events.description: A French Diamant rocket launched the satellite Astérix from Hammaguir in Algeria. France became the third country, after the Soviet Union and the United States, to put a satellite into orbit on its own rocket.
